description: A tender has been floated by the Cyber Police Headquarters to procure around 60 ‘AI Surveillance Drones’ that would help the police with real-time data collection and processing.
body_lead: Eyes in the sky: Kerala Police to introduce AI-powered drones for surveillance, policing Thiruvananthapuram: When Govindachamy, the convict in the sensational Soumya murder case, broke out of a high-security prison in Kannur in the early hours of July 25, it took the police nearly 9 hours to track him down and recapture him from a well, 3.5 kilometres away, despite a statewide manhunt and scanning hundreds of CCTV footages. And the story could have ended much differently without the help of vigilant citizens who recognised him on the roads, which led to his recapture.
